doc: Project-owned npm supply-chain policy for pulse-app/ui, evaluated by `cargo xtask check:npm-supply-chain` (xtask/src/npm_gate.rs). Advisory exceptions are GHSA-id-scoped; license exceptions are package-scoped; both carry provenance and a closing condition and are PRUNED once the condition fires (security-plan §Dependency Security: a finding with a stated safe forward upgrade is never excepted — it stays red until upgraded). License source is package-lock.json license fields (906/909 coverage measured 2026-08-30); class split rides the lockfile dev flags: runtime = prod-reachable (Vite-bundled into the shipped webview), dev = harness/build-only.

advisory_exceptions.reason: no fixed version exists — the advisory's vulnerable range is '*'; reached via puppeteer/@puppeteer/browsers under webdriverio 9 and under pa11y-ci 4.1.1 (latest), which internally nests pa11y 9 although the top-level pa11y is 10. Dev/harness-only chains, no runtime or bundle path.
advisory_exceptions.closing_condition: upstream publishes a fixed extract-zip (or the advisory range narrows) and the puppeteer chains move onto it, or both consuming chains (webdriverio, pa11y-ci) drop extract-zip; prune when the gate runs green without this entry

Same chains as GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv: puppeteer/@puppeteer/browsers under webdriverio 9 and pa11y-ci 4. Dev/harness-only, no runtime or bundle path.

advisory_exceptions.reason: fixed only at >=11.0.1 and no holder admits 11: minimatch 3.1.5 under eslint 9 / @eslint/config-array / @eslint/eslintrc (^3.1.5) and eslint-plugin-react / eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y (^3.1.2), 9.0.9 under @wdio/config's glob 10.5.0 (^9.0.4), 10.2.5 under @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree and 10.2.6 under readdir-glob (^10.2.2); every holder's latest release, eslint 10 included, still requires 3.x or 10.x. npm's suggested remediations are major DOWNGRADES (eslint 4.0.0, webdriverio 8.6.1, pa11y-ci 1.2.0), rejected, as is an override to 11 under holders that do not admit it. Dev-only lint and harness chains, no runtime or bundle path.
advisory_exceptions.closing_condition: the lint and harness holders (eslint and its plugins, typescript-estree, readdir-glob, @wdio/config's glob) move onto minimatch >=11.0.1 or drop it; prune when the gate runs green without this entry

advisory_exceptions.reason: vulnerable >=9.0.0 <=14.0.1; glob 10.5.0 is held by @wdio/config 9 (^10.2.2), and @wdio/config's latest release still requires ^13.0.6, inside the range. glob 7.2.3 under globby is outside the advisory. npm's suggested remediation is a major DOWNGRADE of webdriverio (8.6.1), rejected, as is an override to glob 14 under a holder that does not admit it. Dev-only harness chain (webdriverio), no runtime or bundle path.
advisory_exceptions.closing_condition: @wdio/config (webdriverio) moves onto glob >=14.0.2 or drops it; prune when the gate runs green without this entry

advisory_exceptions.reason: fixed only at >=4.6.6; zod 3.25.76 is held by chromium-bidi 14.0.0 and 17.0.2 (^3.24.1), pinned exactly by puppeteer / puppeteer-core 24.43.1 (pa11y-ci 4.1.1 and its nested pa11y 9) and 25.9.0 (pa11y 10, lighthouse 13); only a newer chromium-bidi (zod ^4.6.5) reaches zod 4, through puppeteer releases those harness tools do not admit. npm's suggested remediation is a major DOWNGRADE (pa11y-ci 1.2.0), rejected, as is an override to zod 4 under a holder that requires 3.x. Dev-only a11y harness chains, no runtime or bundle path.
advisory_exceptions.closing_condition: the puppeteer chains under pa11y-ci, pa11y and lighthouse move onto a chromium-bidi that requires zod >=4.6.6, or drop chromium-bidi; prune when the gate runs green without this entry
